description: Curated roster of the AI platforms and agent frameworks in the DC Hub agent ecosystem — each with its recommended DC Hub tools and authentication tier. The roster is BACKEND-OWNED and changes: read the platforms[] array the response returns, and the status on each row (mcp_active / mcp_ready), rather than any list named in this sentence — an enumeration here goes stale the moment the backend adds or drops a platform, which is exactly how a client named here stopped appearing in the roster. ★ These statuses are CURATED EDITORIAL claims, not measurements: the response carries as_of null, so do NOT relay "MCP Active" as though it were a live connection count. Answers "which AI platforms can connect to DC Hub". Try: get_agent_registry. NOTE: this is a curated ecosystem/capability index, NOT live per-caller call/citation telemetry. Do NOT use for platform uptime or feed health (use get_backup_status).
